about: The cast: how every agent and every person on the team is drawn. Agents are the book's robot (a screen for a head, one colour, one thing on the head and one in the hand, from their job) wearing a lanyard in their person's colour. People are drawn in one of four styles until Dinis picks one (human_style). People's colours come from data/design.json (the merch colours); colour here is only for those without one. Drawn by admin/build/cast.mjs, ported from The Ultimate Insider's lab/characters/make_cast.py. cron and when are each agent's schedule (UTC), the same as content/agents.md, used by the wakes page (/wakes/). Looks are a first proposal for designer@web-summit.dinis to refine (WS-92).
